notes: Local warm-page-cache host is not isolated; other chats/workloads may run. Measurements are not a speed claim.
PHP memory limit32M; OPcache enabled, JIT disabled; single PHP worker. RSS sum may count shared pages twice. CPU/RSS samples include entire active runtime and separately Caddy. k6/client excluded.
Logical transferred bytes and log file growth recorded; physical disk I/O not traced.

FPM writes info records through catch_workers_output; RR logs level info persists PHP worker stderr. Log bytes measure full runtime log growth; JSON framing and request ID account for different per-record sizes.

rr.measurement_point: FPM shutdown after emission / RR next request before emission; counters not reset manually

peak_measurement_config:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Platform\DI\Container;
use App\Platform\Http\Middleware\ErrorHandlerMiddleware;
use App\Platform\Http\Middleware\HttpLoggingMiddleware;
use App\Platform\Http\Middleware\Pipeline;
use App\Platform\Http\Middleware\RequestContextMiddleware;
use App\Platform\Http\Middleware\RoutingMiddleware;
use App\Platform\Http\RequestHandler;
use App\Platform\Http\RouteHandlerResolver;
use Psr\Http\Message\ResponseInterface;
use Psr\Http\Message\ServerRequestInterface;

$configure = require dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/tools/http-fixtures/' . (getenv('FILE_CHECK_RR') === '1' ? 'roadrunner.php' : 'config.php');
return static function (Container $container) use ($configure): void {
    $configure($container);
    $container->set(RequestHandler::class, static fn(Container $container): RequestHandler => new readonly class (
        new Pipeline($container->get(RouteHandlerResolver::class), [
            $container->get(RequestContextMiddleware::class),
            $container->get(ErrorHandlerMiddleware::class),
            $container->get(RoutingMiddleware::class),
            $container->get(HttpLoggingMiddleware::class),
        ]),
    ) implements RequestHandler {
        public function __construct(private RequestHandler $handler) {}

        public function handle(ServerRequestInterface $request): ResponseInterface
        {
            $record = static function (): void {
                $path = getenv('WIRE_FILE_DIRECTORY') . '/peak-' . (getenv('FILE_CHECK_RR') === '1' ? 'rr' : 'fpm') . '.jsonl';
                file_put_contents($path, json_encode(['peak_bytes' => memory_get_peak_usage(true), 'usage_bytes' => memory_get_usage(true)], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) . "\n", FILE_APPEND);
            };
            if (PHP_SAPI === 'fpm-fcgi') {
                // FPM resets PHP memory counters on each request; shutdown follows emission.
                register_shutdown_function($record);
            } else {
                // The next request observes the completed preceding RR emission.
                $record();
            }

            return $this->handler->handle($request);
        }
    });
};
